key_insight: Hyperband-optimized XGBoost performed best among the evaluated models for atrial fibrillation detection, achieving a peak F1 score of 96.95%.
clinical_relevance: Improved ECG-based atrial fibrillation classification could support detection workflows, but clinical utility remains to be established.
method: Compared Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, recurrent, deep, and Siamese neural networks.
Tuned models using Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3.
Evaluated inter-patient and intra-patient splits under class imbalance.
evidence_signal: Experiments used PhysioNet ECG datasets with inter-patient and intra-patient evaluation; the abstract does not specify which split yielded the peak F1 score.
watch_item: The abstract does not report prospective clinical validation, limiting conclusions about real-world performance.
paper_title: Enhancing Atrial Fibrillation Detection Through Hyperparameter Optimization
